readings.tension: Unreconciled, the midpoint-derived clavicle (retraction 26.2 deg) puts AC 72.6 mm from the lateral acromion of the Matsumura-placed scapula (source 34 +/- 8 mm): the inputs cannot all hold at their means. The derived retraction is very sensitive to the generic Seth SC anteroposterior position (about 2 deg per mm of the AC posterior component).
readings.clavicle_length: Reconciled joint-centre chord 151.3 mm (Qiu 152.9 +/- 9.3; residual z -0.17). Source cohorts are about 1.71 m.
readings.standing_angle: Reconciled joint-centre clavicle line relative to the thorax: elevation 9.8 deg, retraction 18.4 deg (source surface line 8 +/- 4 and 23 +/- 6). World-frame angles depend on the unresolved thorax pitch; both pitch variants are given.
readings.AC_and_scapula: Reconciled fit chi2 3.38 on 2 dof, every residual within 1.06 SD. AC to lateral acromion 39.7 mm; scapula angles {'internal_rotation': 30.3, 'upward_rotation': 11.3, 'anterior_tilt': 9.7}. AC-GH is {'male_radiologic_28.8': 44.7, 'mixed_cadaver_MRI_24.0': 41.3} against the Seth model's 42.0 mm: bracketed by the two head radii, an independent agreement (GH here is glenoid point plus head radius, not a sphere fit).
readings.stature_scaling: ANSUR 1.82 m biacromial breadth is 425.2 +/- 16.2 mm (skin). Source-scale maximum bony acromion breadth is 418.4 mm; stature-proportional is 437.4 mm. The source-scale offsets fit the 1.82 m breadth better, so they are the preferred provisional variant; the Lee scapula shape itself is already conditioned on 182 cm.
readings.GH: Glenoid shallowest point plus the outward glenoid normal times a humeral-head radius (24.0 or 28.8 mm). Not a measured GH centre.

vertical_relation_check.reading: Bony sources agree (AC about 23-27 mm above IJ); ANSUR living skin puts the acromion only about 3 mm above the suprasternale. With the C7 conflict (living 80.7 mm vs bony 33-58 mm), no single thorax pitch fits both living relations (they pull in opposite directions). One hypothesis fits both: the living suprasternale landmark sits about 25-35 mm lower relative to C7 and the shoulder than the bony IJ of the models. Recorded as a HYPOTHESIS, not adopted: absolute shoulder height relative to the trunk stays OPEN.
